errors.text_span: The sectors appear to be arranged in a clockwise direction, starting from the top, with the largest sector "Транспорт" (Transport) followed by "Индустрия" (Industry), "Домакинства" (Households), "Услуги" (Services), and the smallest sector "Селско стопанство" (Agriculture).
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the clockwise arrangement of the sectors. The actual arrangement, starting from the top (blue sector) and moving clockwise, is Industry (Индустрия), Transport (Транспорт), Services (Услуги), Households (Домакинства), and Agriculture (Селско стопанство). The description provides an incorrect order, starting with Transport instead of Industry.
